infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DataCave uses your camera to complete image-collection quests, like photographing store shelves.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DataCave uses your microphone to complete audio quests, like recording ambient sounds or speech.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DataCave uses your location for location-based quests, like mapping pedestrian paths. You are always in control of what you share.
